item.title: Awake at 3 a.m. and can't get back to sleep? What to do in menopause
item.description: Woken in the night and can't get back to sleep? Evidence-based steps for menopause night waking, from the 20-minute rule to CBT-I, and when to see a doctor.

item.title: Night Sweats Waking Me Up Every Night: What Are My Options?
item.description: Night sweats waking you up? A balanced look at bedroom changes, diaries, hormone therapy, non-hormonal options and CBT, and how to decide with your clinician.

item.title: Why do I wake at 3 a.m. in menopause?
item.description: Waking at 3 a.m. in perimenopause or menopause is common. What sleep research says about hot flushes, lighter sleep and other causes, and when to see a doctor.
